scan_metadata.notes: Fresh shallow clone of default branch (depth 20), so has_uncommitted_changes reflects the clone (false) not the author's working copy. Static HTML/CSS site plus GitHub Actions YAML and netlify.toml; no Python or Node code, so languages_detected is empty and route/data-access detection is not applicable (out of scope for skill version 1.0 for non-Python/Node code, but nothing relevant was found on manual inspection). woff2 fonts and a JPG are binary assets and were not scanned.

findings: Actions pinned to major version tags (checkout@v7, configure-pages@v6, upload-pages-artifact@v5, deploy-pages@v5), not commit SHAs

proper_secret_handling_found.mechanism: ignores .env, .env.*, *.pem, *.key as a backstop; README states no secrets belong in the repo

interfaces.network_binding: none (static files; served by Netlify or GitHub Pages)

what_this_app_can_do: Serves a public single-page 'coming soon' website for the Starship Suits fursuit studio; no forms, scripts, backend or contact route.
capability_summary.who_can_reach_it: Public static site intended for the open internet (starshipsuits.com via Netlify; optional GitHub Pages staging). No authentication, which is appropriate for a public static page; no data is exposed beyond the published web/ directory.

top_findings: No severity-tagged findings; static site with CSP and security headers in netlify.toml
GitHub Actions referenced by version tag rather than commit SHA (informational)
